title: Battle of Karpenisi
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Karpenisi", at revision 1370444838, opens: "The Battle of Karpenisi took place near the town of Karpenisi on the night of 21 August 1823, between units of the Greek revolutionary army and Ottoman troops." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2584330, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1823 battle in Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
